verdict.rationale: Mercury ships several of its own background automations: automatic invoices, receipts auto-attached to card transactions, AI-powered bookkeeping automations synced with QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite, and auto-funding rules for accounts, which a long-time customer confirms using. These are fixed, feature-specific automations rather than a user-configurable automation or agent system, and the API, webhooks, CLI and MCP are developer building blocks that earn no credit here. missing for 10: a general user-defined automation or rules builder, documented scheduled or trigger-based autonomous agent runs, and depth on how auto-funding rules and AI bookkeeping automations are configured.
